rationale: The attached primary-source pages and all supplied dependency sections were inspected without tools. Space-time roles, finite vector components, nonlinear flux freedom, endpoint quantification, subtraction order, and unnormalized spatial integration match (1.10). The predicate is satisfiable by nonconstant classical solutions and does not impose classical smoothness on q itself. The unresolved issue is its requirement that every interval mass have an ordinary derivative at every time, which excludes endpoint crossings of a translating discontinuity. Because the authoritative passage simultaneously displays an ordinary derivative and retains discontinuous solutions without specifying an exceptional-time or trace interpretation, faithful equivalence cannot be certified. Adjudication should settle the source interpretation and then distinguish an accepted literal formulation from a reduced-applicability specialization.
